source.title: The Mad King
source.description: You find a dirty, tattered notebook full of scribbled schematics and notes. It's quite clear even after just a cursory glance that any of these creations could be used to wreak terrible havoc should anyone ever be foolish enough to build them.
source.objective: Bring Thermaplugg's Engineering Notes to Nogg at the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
source.completion:
<Nogg's eyes light up as he reads through the collection of notes and schematics>

I am going to blow so many things up with this stuff.

Good job, <name>. I think this calls for a celebration!
